semantics: Product over j=0,...,211 and correction in the specified 256 integers of the template polynomial. These are finite constants, not variables. Each circuit node denotes a polynomial expression and adds no quantified coordinate.

report.scope: Exact integer-polynomial circuit specification obtained from the 855-variable construction by a proved nonzero-private-anchor, square-rescaling, and reciprocal transformation. Arithmetic characterization inherits the source theorem; no global minimality claimed.
